content_fields.title: Verify that symmetric-key authentication is secure
content_fields.description: Verify the token signature on every request and pin the accepted algorithm.
content_fields.finding: The verifier loads the same weak symmetric key and then disables signature verification outright.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/auth/utils/jwt_auth.py
payload = jwt.decode(
    token,
    SECRET_KEY,
    algorithms=["HS256"],
    options={"verify_signature": True, "verify_exp": True, "require": ["exp", "sub"]},
)
criteria: No code path disables signature verification.
The algorithm list is a fixed literal and does not include `none`.
A token signed with a different key is rejected with 401.
